_readme: Maps each template's product slug to its deliverable filename in this folder. Leave a slug's value as null until the real finished file is ready — thank-you.html falls back to the honest 'you'll receive it by email' message for any slug that is still null. To go live with a template: 1) drop the finished PDF into this deliverables folder, 2) set that slug's value below to the exact filename (e.g. "traditional-wedding-planner.pdf"), 3) commit and push. No code changes needed.
